Story illustration text synchronization

4 November 2026 · Local project · AZ, EN, DE, RU, KY

Reference: the current Word story title and separate moral. Every published story-language entry was compared with its actively mapped illustration. Unused legacy images and unpublished drafts are outside this scope.

Changes: corrected or standardized title and moral lettering directly in the existing images; omitted moral labels. No artwork was regenerated. Updated images retain their dimensions, frames and panel layout. Pixel checks confirm that everything outside the recorded text rectangles is identical; gold decoration inside the rectangles was retained, and new text was fitted clear of it.

Verification: inventory and OCR covered every entry. Every edited panel was rendered from the exact source string and checked for text bounds and decoration clearance. Visual checks covered the standard layouts and the exceptional panels. OCR evidence below can misread characters, particularly in Azerbaijani and Kyrgyz: an OCR difference alone is not proof of a genuine wording error. “Updated” includes source-based standardization where OCR could not establish an exact match.

Limits: no new morals were invented for the five Azerbaijani poems without a separate moral. Story prose and speech bubbles within the artwork were not edited. These are local changes; this report does not claim a production deployment.

Final checks passed: 1,275 image paths and file hashes; exact rendered text and visible glyphs in all 1,513 edited panels; unchanged dimensions and outside-panel pixels in all 998 updated images; site rebuild; German integration audit; three cache-version tests; 20 mobile image checks and 10 report-control checks across light and dark modes. The cache rule also handles the capitalized Illustrations folders used by Azerbaijani poems.

Evidence and verification
Original images were backed up outside the project. The report is self-contained and works offline. It contains no image previews.
